questions.q: A plane flies at a constant airspeed through a constant wind, from city A to city B and then straight back to city A along the same path. Compared to a completely windless day, does the round trip take the same time, more time, or less time?
choices: Exactly the same time, since the headwind and tailwind cancel out
Less time, because the average ground speed is higher
More time than on a windless day
It depends on the wind's direction relative to the flight path
